name: Ghoulish Effigy
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
I live so far from the protection of town, it's a wonder the ghouls and the walking dead haven't eaten me!  In fact, just yesterday a pack of Bone Chewers was pounding on the walls of my house!

I want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for Ghouls.  To do that I need some Ghoul Ribs.  You can get them from Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders.

Get the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.
narrative.objectives: Gather 7 Ghoul Ribs and bring them to Abercrombie at his shack.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, thanks. These will do just the trick!
narrative.requestItemsText: I think I hear a pack of Ghouls scurrying around the back of the house - I better put that effigy up quick! Did you get those Ghoul Ribs for me?

chain.subtitle: 16 quests from level 24 to 35, 15,520 XP in all.

quests.name: The Hermit
quests.objectiveText: Check on the old man in the shack near Raven Hill cemetery.

quests.name: Ghost Hair Thread
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Spectral Comb to Blind Mary.

quests.name: Return the Comb
quests.objectiveText: Return the Ghost Hair Comb to Madame Eva in Darkshire.

quests.name: Deliver the Thread
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Ghost Hair Thread to Abercrombie, in his shack north of the Raven Hill Cemetery.

quests.name: Gather Rot Blossoms
quests.objectiveText: Gather 8 Rot Blossoms and bring them to Tavernkeep Smitts in Darkshire.

quests.name: Juice Delivery
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Zombie Juice to Abercrombie at his shack.

quests.name: Ghoulish Effigy
quests.objectiveText: Gather 7 Ghoul Ribs and bring them to Abercrombie at his shack.

quests.name: Note to the Mayor
quests.objectiveText: Bring Abercrombie's Letter to Ello Ebonlocke, Mayor of Darkshire.

quests.name: Translate Abercrombie's Note
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Letter to Ello to Sirra Von'Indi.

quests.name: Wait for Sirra to Finish
quests.objectiveText: Wait a moment, then speak with Sirra Von'Indi again.

quests.name: Translation to Ello
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Translated Letter to Lord Ello Ebonlocke

quests.name: Bride of the Embalmer
quests.objectiveText: Find Eliza's grave. Retrieve the Embalmer's Heart from her, then return to Ello Ebonlocke.
